thesis:
This run focused on leveraging the Quality Matrix's top picks, emphasizing strong composite scores and exceptional drilling results. We successfully opened long positions on three top picks:

1. **A2 Gold Corp. (AUAU.V)**: Exceptional Gold Grade (93.3 g/t Au) — Open Pit; Moderate Drill Program Type (Exploration vs Resource).
2. **Marimaca Copper (MC2.AX)**: Strong Copper Grade 2.2% over 424m (NGEx Lunahuasi anchor); Moderate Drill Program Type (Exploration vs Resource).
3. **Endeavour Mining (EDV.L)**: Exceptional Gold Grade (278 g/t Au) — Open Pit; Exceptional Economic Studies.

No shorts were opened this run due to the absence of concrete bearish headlines paired with Red-Flag signals. The churn guard prevented reopening positions on GR Silver Mining Ltd., which will be reconsidered in future runs once the cooldown period ends.
